verdict.rationale: Stable exposes a webhooks system (to notify about account events) and a REST API (create Locations, retrieve MailItems, etc.), which are the building blocks an AI-native user could use to wire up background automations, and it also ships some built-in automatic behaviors like auto-routing mail by keyword and automated check deposits. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated automation/workflow engine, scheduled jobs, or agent-oriented automation builder that a user configures to run autonomously — automation would have to be hand-built on top of the API/webhooks. Missing for 10: a first-party automation/workflow builder, scheduling capability, and any documented example of a user-configured autonomous background automation beyond raw webhooks/API primitives.
